reviewedDelta: cp2 covered f657949..ea98154. Coherence: the design holds together. m20-complete's named-case and ADR-order checks moved into milestone-checks (missingNamedCases, checkAdrBeforeRows), and coldDuration moved from last-ci into ci-runs.mjs and is shared, so there is no second copy. gamutLuminance (oklch.ts) is a deliberate inline copy of labToLinear+inGamut+intoGamut+relativeLuminance. gamut-luminance.test.ts pins the copy with toBe equality over a grid, at the edges and at NaN, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed. Two Fixes-ci rows (M20.32, M20.33) dealt with the runtime of one property case. They sped up product code without touching run counts or timeouts. That is legitimate, but it is a warning for M20.6 (planDelta). 2. Spec fidelity: no requirement or plan item was dropped. M20.28's own commit removed the cut its acceptance owed and moved it to the new row M20.35. The backlog header says a checkpoint ratifies that kind of narrowing, so it is ratified here (F5). M20.31 named the stage ('test', with tsc alive) from the job log and the processes orphaned at cleanup, because no test-durations file was written and the artifact host was unreachable. Its acceptance is met in substance. 3. Standards drift: M20.36 changed packages/editor/src/context-menu.tsx with no changeset (git.md rule 6). That turned the changesets leg, green at cp2, red (F2). Every other code commit kept the convention: theme changes stay under ea98154's theme changeset, and harness and ci paths need none. 4. Gate honesty: the gate reads 8/38 (packet). The green legs are the 3 ADR legs, the FR-THM-005 seed leg, spec folders, quarantines, verify and the new cold-setup leg. The changesets leg went from green to red. I ran ciColdReadings/checkColdMedian read-only against GitHub. There are 16 readings 66b5a51..430a273 (313-507 s) with a median of 397 s, and last-ci adds 488 s at 7631c8b, so the median stays 397. The leg is honest as specified, but 8 of the 17 readings are over 420 s, so it passes on runner speed until M20.35 lands. Mutants, judged by reading the code against its tests: (a) checkColdMedian taking the lower middle reading is killed by the 410/430 case. (b) missingNamedCases ignoring status is killed by the skipped case. (c) gamutLuminance skipping the clamp or the bisection is killed by the exact grid. (d) dropping ciColdReadings' on-HEAD filter survives (F4). Nothing is falsely green today. 5. Architecture: theme stays pure. gamutLuminance is exported from oklch.ts but not from index.ts, so the public API does not grow. There are no new dependencies. The osv excusal names one id, with a date that check-osv-expiry watches. ladder-running.mjs is CI-only, injectable and tested. CI: main was red at ea98154, 61217f6, 59560e9, 5ba5217, bff31c1, 4d6dfb4 and 430a273. The last four reds include a macOS job that GitHub never assigned to a runner (annotation 'The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts'; 'capacity constraints ... macOS arm64'). No row or argued line covers that (F1). last-ci reads ci, gates and cold-setup green at 7631c8b (run 44166431665, cold 488 s), so the hold on M20.6 can lift.

findings.summary: In four consecutive main ci runs (44127277869 at 5ba5217, 44140945585 at bff31c1, 44150996065 at 4d6dfb4, 44159904866 at 430a273), a macos-latest job (verify or cli-mcp) was cancelled with zero steps after 16-20 min. The job annotation says 'The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts', with GitHub's macOS arm64 capacity notice. last-ci and check-ci-evidence count these as product reds. Nothing in the harness recognises the cause (no 'not acquired' match in last-ci.mjs or scripts/gates). No row, diagnosis or argued line covers it. The driver held M20.6 for hours on a red that no commit could fix.
findings.evidence: gh api repos/huyz0/fluxion/check-runs/134310594949/annotations; gh run view --json jobs for the four runs: macOS jobs cancelled, steps=0, runner_name empty; grep 'not acquired' scripts/: no match; last-ci at 7631c8b: ci green (44166431665)
findings.suggestion: Open a harness row. last-ci and check-ci-evidence should name a job that no runner acquired (zero steps, the 'not acquired' annotation) separately from a product failure, and print the remedy: re-run the failed jobs on the same sha. A job that never ran never counts as green, and the ci-evidence leg's green-run requirement stays as it is. If the starvation continues across re-runs, set blockedReason. Changing the macOS runner label or the matrix is a human cost decision.

findings.summary: M20.36's acceptance says the Firefox FR-SCR-003 flake is 'fixed at its cause'. progress.md calls the cause 'likely ... not confirmed', because the trace artifact was unreachable. The new browser case proves a real defect: a re-render refocused the first line and reset the scroll. It does not prove that defect caused the Delete miss in a 480 px window.
findings.suggestion: Accept the fix of a proven defect. If 'FR-SCR-003: the screen menu stays reachable from a row near the bottom of a short window' flakes again in any M20 e2e-report, reopen M20.36 rather than quarantine the case, and the final review checks the flake reports.
